decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen is the firm's publicly presented flagship and has won repeated gold medals, so heavy visible commitment and positive results make dropping it very unlikely.
The dark barley malt rye bread survived the 2024 pruning of the other new breads and still has its own page, which shows management has chosen to persist with it, though it has no reported success.
The marzipan stollen complements the flagship stollen line that is central to the firm's seasonal direction, and it is still presented on its own page, so continued commitment is likely.
